name: Input Stats
description: Count your daily keystrokes, mouse clicks and app time, with keyboard and screen click heatmaps
help: Once enabled, stats are collected in the background with ToolForge, even while the window is closed (running in the background). Pause any time in Settings.
Only the number of presses per key and mouse button is counted. Key order and typed text are never recorded, so nothing you typed can be reconstructed.
On macOS, allow ToolForge under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. During secure input such as password fields, the system delivers no keystrokes to any listener.
On Linux only X11 sessions are supported; Wayland does not allow apps to listen to global input.
Data stays on this computer. You can exclude apps and clear everything at any time.

unsupported.wayland: This is a Wayland session, which does not allow apps to listen to global keyboard and mouse input. Switch to an X11 (Xorg) session on the login screen to use this tool.
unsupported.no_display: No graphical session was found (DISPLAY is not set), so input cannot be counted.
unsupported.other: Input statistics are not supported on this system.

permission.message: Allow ToolForge under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. Recording starts automatically once allowed; if it does not, restart ToolForge.

privacy: Only the number of presses per key and mouse button is counted; key order and typed text are never recorded.
Click positions are stored only as the screen cell they fall in (about 64 × 36 cells per display); no screenshots are taken.
Apps are recorded by name and identifier to measure time spent; window titles and contents are never read.
While an excluded app is in front, nothing is counted.
Data is stored in a SQLite database in the ToolForge data folder on this computer and never uploaded.
